recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-34259 unless humans choose to revisit broader historical VSDP documentation outside the narrow removal request.
issue_request: FHIR-34259 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab R5 change request to remove valueset-compose-include-maximumMultiplicity and valueset-compose-include-minimumMultiplicity from the FHIR core ValueSet specification.
initial_application: The two extensions were originally introduced for VSDP under FHIR-26551. FHIR-34259 was applied in May 2022 through PR #1947: commit 6cd93edefb deleted both extension StructureDefinition XML files and their ValueSet-core ImplementationGuide entries, and commit 61b4f0d4a3 removed the corresponding slices from the VSD-aligned ValueSet profile.
additional_context: The current build keeps ValueSet in active resource scope, but current core source no longer contains either removed extension name or canonical URL. The old VSD-aligned profile source file that referenced the slices is no longer present, and the FHIR Extension Pack checkout has no migrated copy of the extensions. FHIR-31395 and related VSDP profile work explain the review context but do not require a separate source change for this issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current core source edit is needed: the requested extension definitions and known references have already been removed.

related_jiras.note: Original Published/Persuasive VSDP issue that added the minimum and maximum multiplicity extensions later removed by FHIR-34259.
